# SymmetryProtectedTopologicalOrder

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Topological order in monitored quantum dynamics that is protected by global symmetries, leading to stable edge modes or nonlocal correlations despite measurements. Enables fault-tolerant topological qubits and error-resilient computation in TCC architectures by leveraging symmetry constraints.
